verdict.rationale: Ollama runs models locally and says local data never leaves the machine. Its desktop app is noted to support multimodal input and Markdown. However, nothing in the evidence documents uploading documents, embedding or indexing them, or automatic retrieval-augmented generation over a user's files. Offline local inference and API building blocks are adjacent capabilities and do not deliver document RAG themselves.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can chat with my own documents entirely offline using automatic retrieval-augmented generation
